messages.name: Zahra Ramazani
messages.text:
I would like to use this space to share a memory from our class.

On Eid Day, I did not expect my teacher (Mr. Dawoood Walizada) to celebrate this occasion with us. However, he surprised us by sharing a special gift in our WhatsApp group. The gift was a song he had created himself, and it was truly surprising and memorable for me.

Even now, listening to that song reminds me of that beautiful moment. From that day on, I realized how kind and creative he is, and I sincerely appreciate him.

Thank you once again Sir for that unforgettable gift ♡
